title: FeedPollVote - Data API
description: Shows how users voted on a poll posted in the feed. This object is available in API version 29.0 and later.

ChoiceId.description: Indicates which choice a user selected on a poll posted in a feed. This is a relationship field.

FeedItemId.description: ID of the feed item for the poll.

usage:
Use this object to query how users voted on a particular poll.
